notes.title: Update 1.01 (All platforms)
notes.notes:
The game's first patch is out! We were able to get quite a few issues in one go. If you run into more issues then feel free to let us know! Below are all the changes and bug fixes we've made to the game. And thank you to everyone who has bought the game so far!

Version 1.01 changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed a typo in one of the attack descriptions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game wouldn't remember some of the settings upon exiting and opening.
[*] Compressed the beginning FMV file size more.
[*] Fixed a bug where hidden spots with money or items would re-stock themselves when re-entering the scene.
[*] During the Stagmoon boss battle, Mye's turn now occurs at a set time in relation to the boss's attacks, in order to prevent unavoidable strong boss attacks.
[*] Items are now displayed in full colour in your inventory regardless of if you can use them inside or outside of battles.
[*] Fixed a bug where resetting settings to defaults did not set the battle box opacity to default.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing Esc to cancel out of picking gamepad controls didn't work.
[*] Fixed a couple spots with wrong collision tiles.
[/list]
